create.name: Martha Beck
create.bio:
Martha Beck is an American sociologist, writer and coach whose work pairs practical self-inquiry with a warm, nature-loving spirituality. She holds three Harvard degrees, including a doctorate in sociology, and for many years wrote a monthly column for O, The Oprah Magazine. Her books include Finding Your Own North Star, Expecting Adam, Steering by Starlight and The Way of Integrity, an Oprah's Book Club pick that uses Dante's journey through the underworld as a map for returning to one's own truth.

She created Wayfinder Life Coach Training, which has trained coaches in many countries, and with her partner Rowan Mangan runs Wilder, an online community for people who feel out of step with ordinary culture. Her teaching leans on stillness, body awareness, imagination, humour and time outdoors, and she often speaks of an essential self that lies beneath social conditioning. Each week she hosts the Gathering Room, a live conversation on spirit and personal growth that is also shared as a podcast and on YouTube. She leads small retreats at Londolozi Game Reserve in South Africa and weekend programmes at Omega in Rhinebeck, New York, and lives in rural Pennsylvania.

books.title: The Way of Integrity: Finding the Path to Your True Self
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: Beck follows Dante's Inferno, Purgatorio and Paradiso as a four-stage route back to living in line with what you know to be true. Each stage comes with short exercises for noticing where outer life and inner truth have drifted apart.

books.title: Finding Your Own North Star: Claiming the Life You Were Meant to Live
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: An early and widely read guide to telling apart the social self, shaped by other people's expectations, and the essential self that knows what it wants. Quizzes and exercises help readers chart a course towards a life that feels like their own.

books.title: The Joy Diet: 10 Daily Practices for a Happier Life
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: Ten small daily habits, starting with a few minutes of doing nothing, that build towards a more joyful and truthful life. The book moves through stillness, desire, risk, creativity, play and connection, one practice at a time.

books.title: Expecting Adam: A True Story of Birth, Rebirth, and Everyday Magic
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: A memoir of the year Beck and her husband, both at Harvard, chose to continue a pregnancy after learning their son would be born with a disability. She describes the unexplained moments of grace that came with it and how they loosened her hold on academic ambition.

books.title: Steering by Starlight: Find Your Right Life, No Matter What!
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: A practical guide to quieting fearful thinking so that the deeper self can be heard. Beck offers tools for meeting the 'stargazer' within and following its signals through change and uncertainty.

books.title: Finding Your Way in a Wild New World: Reclaim Your True Nature to Create the Life You Want
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: Drawing on her time in the African bush, Beck sets out four 'technologies of magic': wordlessness, oneness, imagination and forming. She presents them as ways for natural guides and healers to find their place and work in a changing world.

books.title: Leaving the Saints: How I Lost the Mormons and Found My Faith
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: A memoir of Beck's return to Utah with her young family, her break with the church she grew up in, and the painful family truths she faced along the way. It closes on a broader, more personal faith that grew out of the upheaval.

books.title: Diana, Herself: An Allegory of Awakening (Bewilderment Chronicles)
books.author: Martha Beck
books.description: Beck's first novel follows a photographer stranded in the wild who, guided by a strange cast of animals and helpers, starts to wake up to who she really is. The story turns her ideas about awakening into an adventure tale.

courses.title: North Star Rising: Finding Your Way in Turbulent Times
courses.description: A weekend at Omega's Rhinebeck campus for slowing down and listening again to your own sense of direction. Martha Beck uses humour, reflection and simple practices to help participants reconnect with purpose and choose a next step.

courses.title: Wayfinder Life Coach Training
courses.description: Beck's ICF-accredited coach training, taught online by her and her team. Students first use the Wayfinder tools on their own lives, then learn to coach others with them, inside a large community of trainees.

courses.title: African STAR: A Self-Transformation Adventure Retreat
courses.description: A small-group retreat of up to twelve people at Londolozi Game Reserve in South Africa, coached by Beck, tracker Boyd Varty and her team. Days in the bush are used to sharpen intuition and a sense of belonging; future dates are to be announced and places are by application.

free_resources.title: 5 Paths to Your Purpose
free_resources.description: A free recorded masterclass in which Beck describes five ways a sense of purpose tends to show up in ordinary life. It comes with prompts to help you notice and name the paths already open to you.

flags: She presents herself mainly as a life coach and coach trainer (Wayfinder); the spiritual side (essential self, integrity, Gathering Room) is real and central to her books, but a human may want to confirm the fit.
Email is media@marthabeck.com, a press inbox published (Cloudflare-encoded) on her bio page; her contact page otherwise uses a form, which is in contact_form_url.
The channel @marthabeck on YouTube is not hers (playlists only); her channel is @MarthaBeckauthor, which carries her Gathering Room and Bewildered podcasts.

Expecting Adam is about her son's Down syndrome; the description avoids naming the condition. Leaving the Saints concerns alleged childhood abuse in her family; described neutrally. A human may prefer to drop either.
Her site's coach-training dates look stale (early-bird February dates with no year); price kept as published.
left_out: Book Beyond Anxiety (title names a condition).
Book The Four-Day Win (weight and food).
